test_get_config: test the self_play_train.get_config function to build an RLLib PPO configuration for a MeltingPot substrate
test_train: test the self_play_train.train function to run PPO self-play training iterations on a MeltingPot environment
build_get_config: build an RLLib PPO config for MeltingPot self-play with custom rollout workers, batch sizes, and LSTM cell size
run_train: run self-play training on a MeltingPot substrate using RLLib PPO with a given config and iteration count
test_main: test the self_play_train.main CLI entry point that calls get_config and train with default parameters
